verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted, can run entirely offline with local models, and supports air-gapped deployment with complete network isolation, so conversation data never has to reach a third party that could train on it. However, nothing in the evidence addresses model training directly, and with cloud providers Open WebUI has no documented control over whether that provider trains on the data. missing for 10: an explicit no-training statement or policy, a training opt-out control for connected cloud providers, independent corroboration of the data-handling posture.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
a powerful, provider-agnostic interface for both local and cloud-based models
